IncidentDef.label: Natura pod sprout
IncidentDef.letterText:
A Natura pod has sprouted nearby!

Harvest it to collect a Natura seed. This special seed can be used to plant a sublime Natura tree.

Any colonists with the natural psy-sensitivity gene can meditate near the tree and might be blessed by it. Being blessed by a Natura tree will permanently enhance the psychic sensititvity of the favoured colonist.
